arxiv_id.description: Either new-format YYMM.NNNNN (post April 2007) or pre-2007 7-digit short form. Optional subject prefix (e.g. math.CA/) is accepted but not required; arXiv API responses for pre-2007 papers already drop it. Optional version suffix vN at the end.
